description.value: Cherry Tree Inn is a quiet, family-owned motel set in 1.6 acres of gardens on the Saanich Peninsula, about 10 minutes north of downtown Victoria. It sits near the Galloping Goose Trail, a major multi-use cycling corridor, and is conveniently positioned for cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries, Washington State Ferries, or the Coho Ferry from Port Angeles. The property is pet-friendly and all rooms are non-smoking, offering a low-key countryside feel close to urban amenities.
